dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux
evidence: No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) processing system - editing actual treatment day counts in receipt intermediate files
purpose.summary: ORCR0025 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that reads and edits receipt intermediate files (RECE02), iterating over treatment accounting records (SRYACCT) and treatment action records (SRYACT) to count and update actual treatment days (実日数) per insurance combination. It processes both regular receipt and claim document files.

notable_features: 15 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (CPRCF002.INC, MCPAREA, CPJOBKANRI.INC, etc.)
14 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCMCPSUB, ORCSJOB, etc.)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for batch parameter passing
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode
Japanese comments encoded in EUC-JP/latin-1 decoded
OCCURS clauses for insurance combination tables
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Structured with named SECTIONs and PERFORM...UNTIL loops
Revision history embedded in comments dating from 2000-2002
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in comment text. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Code is truncated at 16000 chars out of 33030 bytes total; the PROCEDURE DIVISION logic is partially visible but the overall structure is clear.
